title: Passenger Doors and Closure Confirmation
description: Request door opening and closing at a stop, then verify that all monitored doors are closed.

steps.instruction: At standstill, select N and check that the cab is in the required door-operation condition.
Request door opening. Watch for the opening transition rather than assuming immediate completion.
Observe and identify the fully OPEN door status.
Request door closing and observe the closing transition.
Confirm the completed CLOSED state and the All Doors Closed lamp before any traction request.

learningObjective: Distinguish door button requests, transitions and a completed door-closed indication.
operatingConditions: Train at standstill with N selected.
The teaching exercise models combined doors rather than vehicle-specific side selection.
expectedObservations: Door state passes through opening and closing transitions.
All Doors Closed is not confirmed during transitions.
Closure confirmation appears only when the monitored doors have finished closing.
debriefQuestions: Does pressing Close prove every door is secured?
What purpose does the door/traction interlock serve?
